speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. To better understand your severe leg pain and bruising, have you noticed any specific tenderness in your bones, especially in your shins or hips?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Leukemia (likely Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia). The combination of fatigue, bruising, fever, and severe bone pain in a 4-year-old is highly suggestive of leukemia until proven otherwise. I will now request a complete blood count (CBC) with differential and a peripheral blood smear to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: CBC_with_differential; REQUEST TEST: Peripheral_Blood_Smear.
